title: hintonia lumana
intro: Hintonia lumana, commonly known as Texas sage or Hinova, is a plant species native to Mexico and parts of the United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support the gut microbiome, alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and enhance cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Hintonia lumana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligosaccharides. Research suggests that these bioactive constituents may help to modulate the gut-brain axis, reduce inflammation, and improve overall well-being.
